title: Workforce housing fee waivers and repayment bill
summary: Bill 48 gives a full fee waiver for workforce housing units at or below 100% of area median income, lets the housing director decide which units qualify, and the waivers were added to the budget's fee schedule. A newer bill, Bill 130, would make developers repay waivers when affordable homes sell in higher price tiers.

timeline.text: The sponsor said a developer that had flipped homes out of affordability came back asking for money.
The sponsor said the original fee waivers were rushed through before the budget.
A bill would make developers repay fee waivers when affordable homes sell in higher price tiers.
Bill 130, 2026, repayment of fee waivers for affordable housing: The fee waiver repayment bill was moved on first reading, but no vote is in the recording.
